summary: The document is a non-functional placeholder containing seven highly ambiguous, subjective statements regarding a food delivery mobile app. It lacks all technical specifications, user roles, data models, security protocols, and acceptance criteria, rendering it completely unusable for engineering or development purposes.

risk_factors.title: Total Absence of Security Architecture
risk_factors.description: The document explicitly states 'No security requirements' and provides no mention of authentication, authorization, data encryption, or API security, leaving the system vulnerable to unauthorized access and data breaches.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define a comprehensive security architecture including OAuth2/OIDC for authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end encryption for PII, and secure API gateway patterns.

risk_factors.title: Undefined Data Privacy and Compliance
risk_factors.description: No mention of GDPR, CCPA, or PCI-DSS compliance, despite handling customer personal data and payment information ('Customers can pay somehow').
risk_factors.mitigation: Specify data retention policies, consent management, and PCI-DSS compliance requirements for payment processing, including tokenization of card data.

risk_factors.title: Unmeasurable Performance Requirements
risk_factors.description: Requirement 3 states 'Delivery should happen fast' without defining latency, throughput, or SLA metrics, making performance testing impossible.
risk_factors.mitigation: Define specific SLAs, e.g., 'API response time < 200ms for 95th percentile', 'Order processing latency < 5 seconds', and 'Delivery ETA accuracy within 10 minutes'.

risk_factors.title: Ambiguous Payment Integration
risk_factors.description: Requirement 4 states 'Customers can pay somehow' without specifying payment gateways, supported currencies, refund policies, or transaction handling logic.
risk_factors.mitigation: Specify supported payment methods (credit card, digital wallets), third-party gateway integrations (e.g., Stripe, PayPal), and transaction state management.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace with measurable UX metrics, e.g., 'App Store rating target of 4.5+ stars' or 'Task completion rate > 90% for core ordering flow'.
Define 'easy' as 'Complete order in no more than 3 taps from app launch' or 'Support address autocomplete and saved addresses'.
Specify restaurant dashboard features: 'Manage menu items (add/edit/delete)', 'Accept/reject orders', 'View daily sales reports'.
Define mandatory notification types: 'Order confirmation', 'Driver assigned', 'Order delivered', 'Promotional offers' with push notification infrastructure.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No distinction between customer, restaurant, driver, or admin roles, making access control impossible to design.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define roles: Customer (order, pay, track), Restaurant (manage menu, accept orders), Driver (accept deliveries, navigate), Admin (manage users, view analytics).

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No detailed functional specifications for ordering, payment, delivery tracking, or restaurant management.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Break down into modules: User Registration, Menu Browsing, Cart Management, Payment Processing, Order Tracking, Driver Assignment, Restaurant Dashboard.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No performance, scalability, availability, or reliability metrics defined.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Specify: 'Support 10,000 concurrent users', '99.9% uptime', 'Data backup every 24 hours', 'Disaster recovery RTO < 4 hours'.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No entity definitions or API contracts, preventing backend development.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define core entities: User, Restaurant, Menu, Order, Payment, Driver, Delivery. Specify RESTful API endpoints with request/response schemas.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: No testable conditions for verifying requirement fulfillment.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: For each requirement, define Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, e.g., 'Given a customer has items in cart, When they click pay, Then payment is processed and order status updates to confirmed'.

ai_recommendations: Completely rewrite the document using a structured requirements template with sections for Functional Requirements, Non-Functional Requirements, User Roles, Data Model, Security, and Acceptance Criteria.
Engage stakeholders to define measurable success metrics for each requirement, replacing subjective terms like 'awesome' and 'easy' with quantifiable KPIs.
Conduct a threat modeling session to identify security risks and define security controls for authentication, authorization, data encryption, and payment processing.
Create a detailed user journey map for each role (Customer, Restaurant, Driver) to derive functional requirements and acceptance criteria.
